name: Code block
description: Formatted code container with header, filename, copy button, line numbers, and token styling for syntax highlighting.

classes.ayy-code-block: Bordered container for code with rounded corners and surface background.
classes.ayy-code-block--numbered: Adds line numbers using CSS counters.
classes.ayy-code-block__header: Top toolbar with filename and copy button.
classes.ayy-code-block__filename: File title, path, or language indicator.
classes.ayy-code-block__copy: Copy button with icon, copied feedback, and tooltip.
classes.ayy-code-block__code: Code element with monospace font and preformatted whitespace.
classes.ayy-token-function: Syntax token for function and method names.
classes.ayy-token-operator: Syntax token for operators and punctuation.

default.looks: Surface background, line border, card radius; preformatted code area.

hover.looks: Copy button text colour and wash-hover background; tooltip appears after a short delay.

pressed.looks: Copy button scales down to 0.96 for tactile feedback.

focus.looks: Copy button shows 2px ring outline with 2px offset.

disabled.none: Code blocks display readable content and are not disabled; copy button remains usable.

selected.none: Code blocks have no selected or checked state; use Choice card or Checkbox for selectable items.

error.none: No error look; show an Alert above the code block for syntax or execution failures.

loading.none: No loading look; show a Skeleton in the shape of the code block while fetching code.

copied.looks: Copy button turns success colour and displays checkmark feedback icon and "Copied!" tooltip.

sizes.density: Padding and copy button follow data-density.
sizes.width: Fills its container width; code pre scrolls horizontally when lines overflow.

js: codeBlockClass({ numbered?, className? }) → string; codeBlockHeaderClass(); codeBlockFilenameClass(); codeBlockCopyClass(); codeBlockPreClass(); codeBlockCodeClass(); copyCodeBlock(button, { code?, timeout?, label?, copiedLabel? }) copies the code and shows the copied state; codeBlockCopyIcon, codeBlockCheckIcon (SVG markup).

react.import: import { CodeBlock, CodeBlockHeader, CodeBlockFilename, CodeBlockCopy, CodeBlockPre, CodeBlockCode } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.numbered: boolean — display line numbers with CSS counters

props.code: string — code string to copy; if omitted, copies text from the nearest code element
props.timeout: number — duration in ms to show the copied state (default 2000)
props.onCopy: (code: string) => void — callback fired when code is copied
props.label: string — accessible label and tooltip before copy (default "Copy code")
props.copiedLabel: string — accessible label and tooltip after copy (default "Copied!")

a11y: Pre element is scrollable via keyboard by adding tabindex="0".
Copy button has an accessible label (aria-label) and announces state changes.
Line numbers use CSS counters with user-select: none to avoid being copied into the clipboard.
Syntax token classes maintain WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast against the surface background in light and dark themes.
do: Use CodeBlock to display snippets, examples, configs, and commands with syntax highlighting.
Include a CodeBlockFilename in the header when showing multiple files or language context.
Include CodeBlockCopy so readers can easily copy snippet contents to clipboard.
Use numbered on multi-line snippets when referencing specific lines in accompanying text.
dont: Don't use CodeBlock for short inline code references — use <code class="ayy-mono"> or Kbd instead.
Don't bake line numbers into the text content — use the numbered variant with CSS counters.
Don't hardcode syntax highlighting colors — use the semantic token classes (.ayy-token-keyword, .ayy-token-string, etc.).
